description: This file implements a key-value pair vector data structure in C, providing functions for initialization, addition, removal, replacement, lookup, validation, and dumping of key-value pairs, supporting multiple data types like strings, unsigned integers, booleans, date-times, hex numbers, and enumerations. It manages memory dynamically for the pairs' keys and values and includes internal helper functions. It appears to be part of a larger project related to data model and argument handling.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Init(kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Initializes a key-value pair vector structure by setting its internal pointer to NULL and entries count to zero.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Add(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the vector with string values, duplicating input strings.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Remove(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key)
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair by key, freeing associated memory and maintaining vector integrity.

methods.name: bool KV_VECTOR_Replace(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * value)
methods.description: Replaces all values associated with a given key with a new string value.

methods.name: bool KV_VECTOR_ReplaceWithHint(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * value,int hint)
methods.description: Replaces the value of a key at a suggested index if found.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddUnsigned(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned value)
methods.description: Adds a key with an unsigned integer value converted to string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddBool(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,bool value)
methods.description: Adds a key with a boolean value converted to string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddDateTime(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,time_t value)
methods.description: Adds a key with a datetime value formatted in ISO8601.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddEnum(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,int value,const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums)
methods.description: Adds a key with an enum value converted to string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddHexNumber(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Adds a key with a binary buffer converted to a hex string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Destroy(kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated memory and resets the vector.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Dump(kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Logs all key-value pairs in the vector for debugging.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_FindKey(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,int start_index)
methods.description: Finds the index of a key in the vector starting from a hint index.

methods.name: char * KV_VECTOR_Get(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * default_value,int start_index)
methods.description: Returns the value associated with a key or a default if not found.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetUnsigned(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned default_value,unsigned * value)
methods.description: Retrieves and converts a key's value to unsigned int, with error handling.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetUnsignedWithinRange(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned default_value,unsigned min,unsigned max,unsigned * value)
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned int value and checks if within specified range.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetInt(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,int default_value,int * value)
methods.description: Retrieves and converts a key's value to int, with error handling.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetIntWithinRange(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,int default_value,int min,int max,int * value)
methods.description: Retrieves an int value and checks if within range.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetBool(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,bool default_value,bool * value)
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from the vector.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetDateTime(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * default_value,time_t * value)
methods.description: Retrieves a datetime value as time_t.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetHexNumber(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned char * buf,int len,int * bytes_copied)
methods.description: Retrieves a hex string and converts to binary buffer.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetEnum(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,void * value,int default_value,const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums)
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes an enumeration value.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_ValidateArguments(kv_vector_t * args,str_vector_t * expected_schema,unsigned flags)
